label: MODEL READOUT, NOT A MEASUREMENT
purpose: Companion f'' sensitivity table required beside any curvature-dependent figure by this task's card and by GOAL-MLKEM-005.yaml completion_criteria C1. Reused verbatim from TASK-20260805-9672b3 (T3) at zero new compute: no new BKZ reduction and no new lattice-estimator invocation was performed by this task.

applies_to.lane_a_reason: The lane (a) bound (G <= log2(1) = 0, bound.md Sec. 2) depends only on the SIGN of convexity and on M = 1. It does not depend on the magnitude of f'', so no sensitivity table applies to it.
applies_to.lane_b_reason: This task computed no numeric G or dbeta/beta figure for lane (b), because no M is sourced (bound.md Sec. 3). This table applies to the SYMBOLIC dbeta/beta formula reproduced there (M left as a free parameter), for use by a future task that does source an M and evaluates the formula.

zero_new_compute.note: All figures below are reused verbatim from coordination/goals/GOAL-MLKEM-005/batches/BATCH-a51f91/tasks/TASK-20260805-9672b3/verification.json, checks V5 and V7, and from results.json. See receipt.json in this task directory for source hashes.

nominal_ceiling_constant.source: ledger/goals/GOAL-MLKEM-005.yaml, ceiling_known_in_advance: 'the single-target optimiser sets f''(beta_1) = -0.292' and the dbeta/beta formula's leading coefficient 0.29.
nominal_ceiling_constant.provenance_note: T3's own results.json labels 0.292 'the card's conversion constant (classical core-sieve exponent)'. It is a DIFFERENT convention from the RC.MATZOV cost model this campaign otherwise uses; the two are compared, not conflated, in the table below.

section_A_RC_MATZOV_measured_bits_per_bl.what: OLS of RC.MATZOV's own reported log2(rop) against beta, across a 41-point scan of the norm-scaling parameter c at each of the three FIPS 203 standardised parameter sets. This is the same style of quantity (bits per block) the nominal 0.292 constant represents, measured empirically under the SAME pinned cost model this campaign uses throughout.
section_A_RC_MATZOV_measured_bits_per_bl.no_propagation_performed: This task does NOT re-derive the ceiling formula's exact functional dependence on this constant and therefore does NOT compute a propagated dbeta/beta or G figure from the ratios below. Only the input-level spread is reported, to avoid presenting an un-derived relationship as a result.

section_B_integer_quantisation_floor_bet.what: RC.MATZOV's own reported beta is an integer-valued, non-monotone staircase in the norm-scaling parameter c over the SAME 40-interval scan grid used in Section A. This is the '3/2/3 anomalous pairs' finding this task's card names by that phrase.
section_B_integer_quantisation_floor_bet.reading: Any single-cell beta or dbeta readout at these standardised parameter sets carries at least this much selection noise (0.45-0.68 blocks OLS residual sd, up to 2 blocks in single anomalous intervals) before any curvature-sensitivity question is asked.

explicit_non_extrapolation: Nothing in this table is transported beyond the three FIPS 203 standardised parameter sets it was measured at (Kyber512/768/1024). No number here is subtracted from the in-repo primal_bdd margins of 2.80 / 6.04 / 1.28 bits. No number here is used to compute a numeric bound for lane (b), since lane (b) has no sourced M (bound.md Sec. 3).
